source.deduplicate: Repeated delivery of the same logical message in later requests is one event; distinct events with identical text remain distinct
source.source_order: Actual creation/delivery order in saved IO and events
source.tool_call_text: Canonical UTF-8 JSON of name and parsed arguments; exact displayed result stays a separate unmodified event

provenance.resolution: Quote must occur exactly once verbatim; code derives offsets at valid UTF-8 boundaries, without whitespace normalization

canonicalization.claim_ids: Checkpoint ID plus original extraction index
canonicalization.duplicates: Drop only exact duplicate research records excluding generated IDs
canonicalization.invalid_record_policy: Fail C and dependent CV/CVP; preserve diagnostics; no silent record dropping or repair

model.runtime: The approved vLLM image, TP1, context32768, max-num-seqs1, auto BF16 KV, same L40
model.response_format: Plain JSON completion validated by code; no guided-decoding mode, repair call, or new lookup

V.implementation: One source-only LLM support table for the actually packed C

P.implementation: One source-only LLM transfer table for CV, with the closed rubric in the prompt

limits.max_input_tokens: 32768 minus the stage output reserve; full rendered request, with no truncation

packing.C: Keep the longest initial sequence of whole ordered records that fits; no skipping a large record to fit later records
packing.S: Join the longest initial sequence of complete returned sentences that fits; no rewrite or regeneration
packing.CV_CVP: Deletion only from delivered C, byte-identical records in the original order; no backfill
packing.F: Full permitted archive, no truncation; stop and ask if an affected continuation input would overflow
packing.zero_valid_S_or_C: package_build_failure, never a successful empty archive

human_audit.selection: All 12 native checkpoints, fixed before observing memory quality
human_audit.order: Source units independently first, then extraction matching and V/P labels, then preserved adjudication
human_audit.native_verified_gate: Human review of group1 before groups2-3; their review before expanding to the remaining approved groups
